question: Which of the following persons played the Shehnai at the Red Fort to celebrate the occasion of India's independence in August 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is __** Bismillah Khan. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bismillah Khan played the shehnai on **15 August 1947** at the **Red Fort.** He was the first Indian to hail the nation with his musical instrument.
 
• **This event was major because we got independence on that day. **
 
• Khan's music echoed from the ramparts of **Red Fort in New Delhi on August 1947 **the day India declared its independence from the 200- time-old** **British rule. He also performed on the country's first Republic Day form on January 26, 1950.
 
• Khan continues to be one of the many musicians to have entered the **Bharat Ratna, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, and Sangeet Natak Akademi awards. __**
 
• Khan is the man who introduced the world to the air of Indian classical music and created a unique space for himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan was** **born in Bihar on March 21, 1916. **
 
• **Shehnai,** double-wimp conical oboe of North India.
 
• The shehnai is made of wood, except for a glaring essence bell attached to the bottom of the instrument, and measures about 12 – 20 elevation( 30 – 50 cm) in length, with six to eight crucial cutlets holes along its body.
 
• **Ali Bux** was **the official shehnai player of the Vishnu temple in Varanasi**.
